projects.title: Onboarding Flow Revamp
projects.description: Simplify the three-step signup into one screen. Reduces drop-off and removes the abandoned 'verify email' dead end.

projects.title: Billing Portal
projects.description: Let customers update cards and download invoices without emailing support. Includes usage-based proration for mid-cycle plan changes.

projects.title: Search Performance
projects.description: P95 search latency is over 2s on large datasets. Add a search index and query caching to get it under 400ms.

projects.title: Mobile App Shell
projects.description: Native app scaffold with the dashboard's component set ported. Target: iOS and Android from one codebase.

projects.title: Audit Log Export
projects.description: Compliance needs a one-click CSV/JSON export of admin actions with time-range and actor filters.

projects.title: Notification Preferences
projects.description: Per-channel (email, in-app, push) and per-topic opt-in controls. Currently every user gets every email.
